style_description: Painterly soft-cel illustration style. Anthropomorphic cat characters with expressive faces and strong personality silhouettes. TRANSPARENT PNG backgrounds required on ALL assets — no baked-in background colors or grey backdrops. Warm and cozy café mood. Thick-ish outlines, clean digital art with soft shading (not hard cel-flat). Consistent lighting direction: warm top-left key light, cool bottom-right shadow.

palette.rule: Clamp ALL asset colors to the palette above. No fluorescent values. No pure-white highlights — use #FFF8F0. No pure-black — use #2F1B14.

characters.framing: Full-body, center-aligned, subject fills 70-80% of canvas height. Consistent subject height across all sprites so they sit at the same visual weight when placed side-by-side.
characters.portrait_variant: Shoulders-up crop at 1:1 ratio (512×512px). Same lighting, same expression consistency.
characters.background: TRANSPARENT — no background fill of any kind.
characters.style_notes: All characters are anthropomorphic cats. Proportions: expressive head ~40% of body height, compact body, visible tail. Soft-cel shading with warm top-left key. TRANSPARENT background required. Same scale and proportions across all sprites.

cakes.fresh: Vivid, vibrant presentation — peak glow, garnishes intact.
cakes.stale: Noticeably faded — 50% saturation, drooping garnish, slight greyness.
cakes.background: TRANSPARENT — no grey backdrop, no plate shadow baked in.
cakes.style: Isometric-ish top-down 3/4 view. Soft gouache/painterly look. Palette-clamped colors.

catalogue.description: Three-milk sponge cake, white layered with cream and a dusting of cinnamon
Elegant choux pastry éclair with glossy dark chocolate glaze and cream filling — on-palette browns and creams only
Layered tiramisu with coffee-dusted mascarpone layers
Black Forest cake with cherries, whipped cream, and chocolate shavings
Matcha Swiss roll with muted green sponge and cream filling

customers.style_notes: Human or stylized humanoid characters (NOT cats). Bust / portrait crop at 1:1. TRANSPARENT background. Warm top-left key lighting matching the character art. Each customer should read as a distinct archetype (tourist, hipster, foodie, romantic, business, student, elder local, artist).

ui.coin: Small gold coin icon, painterly not flat vector, on-palette gold (#C49A30). TRANSPARENT background. 64x64px.
ui.shelf_plank: Single wooden café shelf plank, warm oak tone (#D4A574 to #B8935F). Slight top highlight (white gleam). Transparent above and below — just the plank shape. 512x64px.

environment.style_notes: Warm French café interior. Wooden shelves, warm ambient lighting, chalkboard menus, pastry display. Painterly style matching character art. Warm espresso and cream palette.

style_notes: Mobile HTML5 language learning game. Warm, whimsical, approachable tone. All sprites MUST have transparent PNG backgrounds. Consistent lighting across all assets: warm key top-left, cool shadow bottom-right. Colors must stay within the defined palette — no fluorescents, no pure black/white.
